description: This file defines the MetricsSystem class for Spark, managing metrics collection, registration, and reporting, including sinks and sources, with support for web UI integration.

classes.name: MetricsSystem
classes.description: Manages Spark metrics collection, registration, sinks, sources, and web UI handlers.

methods.name: getServletHandlers
methods.description: Returns UI handlers; requires MetricsSystem to be running.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the metrics system, registers static sources and sinks, and begins reporting.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the metrics system and clears registered metrics.

methods.name: buildRegistryName
methods.description: Builds a unique name for a metric source based on app and executor IDs.

methods.name: getSourcesByName
methods.description: Retrieves sources matching a given name.

methods.name: registerSources
methods.description: Registers sources defined in configuration for the current instance.

methods.name: registerSinks
methods.description: Registers sinks and web UI servlets based on configuration.

methods.name: metricsProperties
methods.description: Returns the properties used for metrics configuration.
